title: Module Entry Request
description: Generic request to initialize a specific module instance.

moduleInstanceId.description: Host-generated identifier of the module instance.

entryPoint.description: Identifier of the requested module entry point.

parameters.description: Module-specific initialization parameters. The target module owns their schema.

context.description: Shared application context snapshot provided by the Host.

correlationId.description: Identifier used to correlate this request with related operations.
